I changed it to `paint`, which is the material's color parameter (`param paint : ColorLinear`).

I re-ran `ara_why` on the radio afterwards. The material check now passes and nothing else is flagged. The renderer-pass check can only run in the live renderer, so I haven't seen the radio on screen. Please check it in the outpost level.
